newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close mixed as key blue chips fall.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close mixed as key blue chips fall.

text.p: A handful of blue chips led by Telekom dragged the key share index to a lower close on late fund selling, traders and analysts said.
But the market's main focus remained on lower liners of the main board.
They said institutions were trimming positions in selective core stocks to reel in profits. "The play today is on small stocks which are rising," said a K&N Kenanga dealer.
The Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks fell 2.22 points to 1,214.42 after trading narrowly on both sides of Wednesday's close.
The broad Emas index was up 0.48 to 347.38, and the Second Board rose 3.57 to 597.92.

Heavyweight Telekom dropped 40 cents to 20.60 ringgit on negative sentiments over government investigations into alleged discrepancies in a tender awarded to Swedish telecoms firm Ericsson, analysts said.
"It's not good news for Telekom, even though it really has no immediate impact on the company's earnings," said Phuah Lee Kerk, analyst at Vickers Ballas.
Even before the Ericsson news, Telekom was already weighed down by worries of rising industry competition, analysts said.
